Translation.llm_provider_tips.ollama:
##### Ollama Configuration
- **API Key**: not required
- **Base Url**: usually `http://localhost:11434/v1` for local runs or `http://host.docker.internal:11434/v1` for Docker{docker_hint}
- **Model Name**: required; run `ollama list` and enter an installed model, such as `qwen:7b`
Translation.llm_provider_tips.claude_code:
##### Claude Code Configuration
- **API Key**: not required; the local `claude` CLI authenticates with your Claude subscription (Pro / Max / Team)
- **Base Url**: not required
- **Model Name**: optional; leave empty to use the CLI default, or set `claude-opus-5` / `claude-sonnet-5`
- **Claude CLI Path**: optional; leave empty to resolve `claude` from PATH
- Requires the CLI to be installed and logged in where YenguiVideoPrinter runs. In Docker, pass a `claude setup-token` token as `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN`
- Requests use your Claude subscription usage limits. Conflicting `ANTHROPIC_*` / `CLAUDE_CODE_USE_*` environment variables are stripped before the CLI runs, so an API key in the environment cannot silently bill your API account
Translation.llm_provider_tips.ollama.docker_hint: > Container environment detected. If Base Url is empty, `http://host.docker.internal:11434/v1` is used by default.
Translation.llm_provider_tips.openai:

- **Base Url**: defaults to `{default_base_url}`; enter another endpoint when using a compatible service
- **Model Name**: defaults to `{default_model}`; you can also enter another model ID available to your account
> Accessing the official service may require a network proxy in some regions

When selected, LoomLoom script and video generation automatically reuse this API Key.

Translation.llm_provider_tips.moonshot:
##### Kimi / Moonshot Configuration
- **API Key**: register through the [YenguiVideoPrinter link (10% bonus API credit on your first top-up)]({api_key_url}) and create one in the console
- **Base Url**: defaults to `{default_base_url}`
- **Model Name**: defaults to `{default_model}`; see the [model list]({model_docs_url})

Why recommended:
- **Fits the video creation workflow**: helps generate scripts, extract stock-footage search keywords, and improve final footage relevance
- **Strong long-context capability**: useful for longer topics, batch scripts, and complex prompts
- **Exclusive offer for new users**: receive bonus API credit equal to 10% of the first successful top-up, up to CNY 1,000; offer ends December 31, 2026

Translation.llm_provider_tips.cloudflare:
##### Cloudflare AI Gateway Configuration
- **API Key**: create a token in the [Cloudflare dashboard]({api_key_url}) with `AI Gateway - Read`, `AI Gateway - Edit`, and `Workers AI - Read` permissions
- **Account ID**: enter your Cloudflare account ID
- **Gateway ID**: defaults to `{default_gateway_id}`; you can also enter an existing Gateway ID
- **Base Url**: not required; the REST API endpoint is generated from the Account ID
- **Model Name**: defaults to `{default_model}`; use the `provider/model` format for another model supported by AI Gateway
Translation.llm_provider_tips.minimax:
##### MiniMax Configuration
- **API Key**: create one on the [China platform](https://platform.minimaxi.com/) or [international platform](https://platform.minimax.io/)
- **Base Url**: use `https://api.minimaxi.com/v1` for China or `{default_base_url}` for international access (default)
- **Model Name**: defaults to `{default_model}`; you can also enter another model ID available to your account

Make sure the API Key and Base Url belong to the same platform, or authentication may fail.

Translation.LoomLoom Video Terms Reuse Help: LoomLoom script candidates already include video terms. Select a candidate or edit the terms below; no separate local LLM call is needed.
Translation.Shengsuan Cloud AI Video Help: Generate 1 to 5 paid AI video clips through the current LoomLoom video Listing. Models are loaded from the authenticated capability profile. Review and confirm the quote before using the existing narration, subtitle, and editing pipeline.
Translation.AI Video Model Reference Price: Reference price: {price}, for guidance only. Final charges are based on actual model usage.
Translation.AI Video Model List Load Failed: Could not load the video model list: {error}
Translation.Selected AI Video Model Unavailable: The selected model is no longer available. Refresh the model list, choose another model, and get a new quote.
Translation.Selected AI Video Ratio Unavailable: The selected aspect ratio is not supported by the current video capability profile.
Translation.AI Video Quote Estimate Incomplete: A complete cost estimate is not currently available. Charges may still apply; final billing is based on actual model usage.
Translation.Confirm AI Video Charge: I understand that AI video generation is a paid service
Translation.Confirm AI Video Charge Help: Execution uses the Listing version returned by this quote and a stable idempotency key. The final charge is based on actual model usage and may be nonzero even when the estimate is incomplete.
Translation.AI Video Quote Required: Get a current Shengsuan Cloud AI video quote before generating the video.
Translation.Confirm AI Video Charge Required: Confirm the Shengsuan Cloud AI video charge before generating the video.
Translation.AI Video Quote Retained For Retry: Generation failed, but the confirmed quote was retained. You can retry safely with the same request or request a new quote.
Translation.LoomLoom Poll Retry Pending: The service is temporarily unavailable. Retrying in {seconds} seconds...
Translation.LoomLoom Poll Retry Warning: The service is temporarily unavailable. Status check {attempt}/{max_attempts} failed and will retry automatically.
Translation.Stop Tracking LoomLoom Run Help: Stops local status checks only. It does not cancel a paid run that may still be active on Shengsuan Cloud.

- **Model Name**: defaults to `{default_model}`; use the `provider/model` format and see the [Provider list](https://docs.litellm.ai/docs/providers)
Translation.Automatically publish generated videos t: Automatically publish generated videos to social media using upload-post.com
Translation.Upload-Post API Key Help: Create and copy an API key on the [Upload-Post API Keys page]({api_keys_url}).
Translation.Upload-Post Profile Username Help: Enter the Username shown on [Manage Users]({manage_users_url}), not your Upload-Post account email. This publishing user must be connected to the selected platforms.
Translation.Upload-Post Setup Guide:
Before enabling auto-publish:
1. Create an API key on [API Keys]({api_keys_url}).
2. Create or select a publishing user on [Manage Users]({manage_users_url}), then connect the target platforms.

Enter that publishing user's **Username** below, not your Upload-Post account email.
Translation.OFox AI Video Help: One key for multi-model video creation, with direct access to official model providers. Pay as you go: stable, fast, and unlimited.
Translation.OFox Billing Notice: Each generated clip is billed by OFox. Based on the estimated voiceover duration and clip duration, roughly {min}-{max} paid task(s) will be submitted. Generation stops as soon as enough footage is collected.
Translation.OFox Billing Notice Without Script: Each generated clip is billed by OFox. Enter or generate the video script to see an estimated task count.
Translation.Confirm OFox Charge: I understand OFox video generation creates paid tasks
Translation.Confirm OFox Charge Help: OFox clips are submitted one at a time and stop once they cover the voiceover duration. OFox bills each submitted generation task.
Translation.Confirm OFox Charge Required: Please confirm the OFox charge before generating the video.
Translation.OFox Upstream Vendor Help: Which upstream vendor serves OFox video generation. BytePlus (international) is the default with a consistent content policy; Volcano Engine is the mainland-China vendor; Auto lets the OFox gateway load-balance across vendors.
Translation.MuAPI AI Video Help: Generate paid AI video clips through MuAPI's asynchronous text-to-video API, then reuse the existing narration, subtitle, and editing pipeline.
Translation.MuAPI API Key Help: Create a MuAPI API key and keep it private. MuAPI generation is billed per submitted task.
Translation.MuAPI Base URL Help: The API root used for MuAPI requests. The default is https://api.muapi.ai/api/v1.
Translation.MuAPI Video Endpoint Help: A relative asynchronous text-to-video endpoint below the MuAPI base URL, for example seedance-lite-t2v.
Translation.MuAPI Resolution Help: Resolution sent to the selected MuAPI endpoint. The default budget route accepts 480p, 720p, and 1080p.
Translation.MuAPI Billing Notice: Each generated clip is billed by MuAPI. Based on the estimated voiceover duration and clip duration, roughly {min}-{max} paid task(s) will be submitted. Generation stops as soon as enough footage is collected.
Translation.MuAPI Billing Notice Without Script: Each generated clip is billed by MuAPI. Enter or generate the video script to see an estimated task count.
Translation.Confirm MuAPI Charge: I understand MuAPI video generation creates paid tasks
Translation.Confirm MuAPI Charge Help: MuAPI clips are submitted one at a time and stop once they cover the voiceover duration. An ambiguous submission is not retried because it may already have created a billable remote task.
Translation.Confirm MuAPI Charge Required: Please confirm the MuAPI charge before generating the video.
Translation.YVP Generate Hint: All set? The video is rendered locally and progress appears below.
Translation.Generate Share Text: Generate title and description with AI
Translation.Share Hint YouTube: Opens YouTube Studio. A vertical video under 3 min is published as a Short.
Translation.Share Hint TikTok: Opens TikTok Studio: drop the video and paste the description.
Translation.Share Hint Instagram: On instagram.com, click "+ Create" then "Post": a vertical video becomes a Reel.
Translation.Share Hint Facebook: Opens Facebook Reel creation (on your profile or a Page).
Translation.User Assets Help: Add your own photos or videos (up to {limit} files, {size} MB in total). The AI looks at them, writes the script around them and places each one at the right moment; stock footage fills the rest. A long video gives up to 3 different shots.
Translation.User Asset Caption Placeholder: Optional caption: what the image cannot show (name, place, message)
Translation.Analyzing User Assets: The AI is looking at your photos and videos…
Translation.Vision Model Unavailable: The vision model is unavailable (Ollama stopped or model not installed). Your captions will still be used.
Translation.User Assets Stock Only: Your assets are mixed with stock footage: choose Pexels, Pixabay or Coverr as the video source.
Translation.User Assets Limit: Only the first {limit} files within {size} MB will be used.
Translation.Video Quality Help: Fast: footage taken in search order, quick encoding. Balanced: the AI picks the best footage among 3 per passage. High: the AI compares 6 clips per passage and adds free photos when nothing fits, best encoding. Times are estimates that adjust to your computer after each video.
Translation.Camera Studio Help: Film yourself talking in front of the background of your choice (up to {minutes} min).
Translation.Camera Placeholder: Turn on the camera to see yourself here with your background.
Translation.Camera No Microphone: No microphone found: the video will have no sound.
Translation.Camera Error Unsupported: This browser cannot record video. Use Edge or Chrome.
Translation.Camera Error Permission: Camera access denied. Allow the camera in the browser (icon in the address bar), then try again.
Translation.Camera Error Camera: The camera cannot be opened (already used by another app?).
Translation.Camera Error AI: Background cut-out unavailable: only the original background works.
Translation.Camera Error Too Big: Take too large: record a shorter video.
Translation.Camera Delete Confirm: This recording will be deleted permanently.
Translation.Camera Add Clip: Add the excerpt to my videos
Translation.Camera Clip Added: Excerpt added to “My photos and videos”
Translation.Camera Saved Where: Your video is saved in this folder:
Translation.Camera Saved Hint: To watch it, click “Watch the video” or open the folder.
Translation.Camera Saved Headless: Find it in this folder on the computer running YVP.
Translation.Camera Open Failed: Could not open the video or its folder.
Translation.Camera Card Hint: Optional · film yourself in front of a background, then use the video in your edit
Translation.Camera Use In Edit Hint: To use it in the edit: card 1 › “My photos and videos” › “From my recordings”.
Translation.Camera From Recordings Empty: No recordings yet: film yourself in the Camera studio at the top of the page.
Translation.Camera From Recordings Help: Pick a recording and the passage to keep (up to {seconds} s). The AI places it in the video; a long passage gives up to 3 shots.
Translation.Camera Zoom Hint: Mouse wheel or +/− to zoom · drag to reframe · double-click: 100%
Translation.Camera Zoom Quality: Above 150% the image gets blurry (720p webcam)
Translation.Stage Taking Longer: taking longer than expected ({elapsed} so far), still working
Translation.Target Video Duration Max Help: The AI writes a script of this spoken length. {seconds} s maximum: beyond that, rendering gets long and quality drops (repeated shots, enlarged sources).
Translation.Own Script Too Long: Your script lasts about {seconds} s when read aloud: beyond {max} s the video takes long to render and loses quality. Shorten it.
Translation.Camera Clip Aspect Mismatch: This recording is not in the same format as the video (portrait/landscape): it will be cropped and enlarged, so blurry. Better to film yourself again in the video's format.
Translation.Share Step Download: Download the video (button under the player)
Translation.Camera Cut Done: Cut version created (the original is kept)
Translation.Camera From Recordings Toggle: Add a passage from my recordings
Translation.Camera From Recordings Toggle Help: Turn on to pick a passage from your camera recordings. Nothing is added until you click “Add the excerpt to my videos”.
Translation.User Assets None Used: Nothing added: the video will only use stock footage.
Translation.Voice Language Mismatch: This voice speaks {voice} but the script language is {script}: it cannot read it and no audio will be produced. Choose a {script} voice, or change the script language (card 1).
Translation.Explainer Card Hint: Optional · the AI writes an animated explainer (diagrams, arrows, subtitles) on any topic
Translation.Explainer Help: Language: {language} (card 1) · voice: the one chosen in card 3. About 20 seconds, vertical.
Translation.Explainer Topic Placeholder: e.g. How DNS works when you type a web address
Translation.Explainer Facts Help: The AI reads the Wikipedia summary of the topic before writing, to stay accurate. Without internet, the video is made without it.
Translation.Explainer Writing: The AI is writing the plan (facts, scenes, icons)…
Translation.Explainer Failed: The video could not be created: {error}
Translation.Explainer Elements Help: Name each element and describe its icon in a few English words (e.g. drone, delivery truck): the closest icon is used.
Translation.Explainer Element Icon Help: Built-in icons: phone, laptop, browser, server, database, cloud, lock, user, globe, api, router, cache, shield, file. Anything else is searched among 5,000 icons.
Translation.Headshot Card Hint: Optional · turn your own photos into professional LinkedIn headshots, generated on your PC
Translation.Headshot Help: You need {minimum} to {maximum} photos of yourself: take them with the guided capture (recommended) or import them. Nothing leaves your PC, and the photos are erased once generation is done.
Translation.Headshot Estimate: Estimated time: about {minutes} min on a GTX 1070. You can keep using YVP meanwhile.
Translation.Headshot Review Hint: Check every photo before publishing: AI can alter details (hands, clothes, accessories).
Translation.Headshot No GPU: An NVIDIA graphics card is required to create LinkedIn photos on this PC.
Translation.Headshot Install Needed: First use: YVP must install the image generation tools (PyTorch, about 3 GB). The models (about 8 GB) download at the first generation.
Translation.Headshot Installing: Installing… (several minutes depending on your connection)
Translation.Headshot Error Not Installed: The tools are not installed yet.
Translation.Headshot Error Unreadable: One of the photos cannot be read.
Translation.Headshot Error Windows: Automatic installation is not available on Windows yet.
Translation.Headshot Error Not Enough Faces: Fewer than {usable} usable photos: add photos where your face is sharp, from the front and alone.
Translation.Headshot Error No Cuda: The graphics card is not available (CUDA).
Translation.Headshot Error Out Of Memory: Not enough video memory: close other programs using the graphics card (games, Ollama…) and try again.
Translation.Headshot Error Crashed: Generation stopped unexpectedly. Try again; if it persists, choose Fast quality.
Translation.Headshot Capture Help: The camera opens in the middle of the screen. Follow the instructions: YVP takes 8 photos from different angles as soon as the pose is right. Face a window or a lamp.
Translation.Headshot Capture Loading: Loading the camera and face tracking…
Translation.Headshot Capture Too Few: A few more photos: let's redo the skipped poses.
Translation.Headshot Capture Error Permission: Camera access denied: allow it in your browser.
Translation.Headshot Step Side: Turn your head slightly to one side
Translation.Headshot Step Slight Smile: Slight smile, head a little turned
Translation.Headshot Hint No Face: Place your face in the oval
Translation.Headshot Hint One Person: Only one person in front of the camera
Translation.Headshot Hint Center: Center your face in the oval
Translation.Headshot Hint Turn More: Turn your head a bit more
